import json, urllib.request, ssl, base64, hashlib

# Domain allowlist: skip known-good domains that produce FP TI matches.
# These domains are in OpenCTI because TI feeds include them as infrastructure
# for threat actors (C2 fronting, etc.), but in this homelab they are legitimate.
# Review and prune this list quarterly.
ALLOWED_DOMAIN_SUFFIXES = [
    ".google.com",
    ".googleapis.com",
    ".gstatic.com",
    ".discord.gg",
    ".discord.com",
    ".discordapp.com",
    ".docker.io",
    ".docker.com",
    ".microsoft.com",
    ".azure-dns.com",
    ".azure.com",
    ".anthropic.com",
    ".in-addr.arpa",
    ".meethue.com",
    ".gvt1.com",
    ".adobe.io",
    ".asus.com",
]

def is_allowed(value):
    if not value:
        return False
    v = value.lower().rstrip(".")
    return any(v.endswith(s) or v == s.lstrip(".") for s in ALLOWED_DOMAIN_SUFFIXES)

ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
creds = "$elk_user:$elk_pass"
auth = base64.b64encode(creds.encode()).decode()
headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Basic {auth}"}

query = {
    "track_total_hits": True,
    "size": 100,
    "sort": [{"@timestamp": "desc"}],
    "query": {
        "bool": {
            "filter": [
                {"term": {"tags": "tier1_ti_match"}},
                {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-10m"}}}
            ]
        }
    }
}

events = []
raw_count = 0
try:
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "$elk_url/logs-zeek.haccp-default/_search",
        data=json.dumps(query).encode(),
        headers=headers,
        method="POST"
    )
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=15)
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    hits = data.get("hits", {}).get("hits", [])
    raw_count = len(hits)

    seen = {}
    for h in hits:
        src = h.get("_source", {})
        ti = src.get("ti", {})
        llm = src.get("llm", {})

        match_field = ti.get("match_field", "")
        matched_value = ""
        if match_field == "id_resp_h":
            matched_value = src.get("id_resp_h", "")
        elif match_field == "server_name":
            matched_value = src.get("server_name", "")
        elif match_field == "query":
            matched_value = src.get("query", "")
        elif match_field == "host":
            host_val = src.get("host", "")
            if isinstance(host_val, str):
                matched_value = host_val
        elif match_field == "sha256":
            matched_value = src.get("sha256", "")

        # Skip allowlisted domains (still logged in ES, just not cased).
        # IP-based (id_resp_h) and file-hash (sha256) matches are never skipped.
        if match_field in ("server_name", "query", "host") and is_allowed(matched_value):
            continue

        community_id = src.get("community_id", "")
        if community_id:
            dedupe_key = f"cid:{community_id}"
        else:
            dedupe_key = f"mf:{match_field}:{matched_value}:{src.get('id_orig_h','')}"

        if dedupe_key in seen:
            continue

        seen[dedupe_key] = True
        events.append({
            "zeek_uid": src.get("uid", ""),
            "timestamp": src.get("@timestamp", ""),
            "id_orig_h": src.get("id_orig_h", ""),
            "id_resp_h": src.get("id_resp_h", ""),
            "id_resp_p": src.get("id_resp_p", 0),
            "community_id": community_id,
            "ti_type": ti.get("type", ""),
            "ti_provider": ti.get("provider", ""),
            "ti_confidence": ti.get("confidence", 0),
            "ti_match_field": match_field,
            "ti_matched_value": matched_value,
            "llm_classification": llm.get("classification", ""),
            "llm_confidence": llm.get("confidence", 0),
            "llm_summary": (llm.get("summary", "") or "").replace('"', "'").replace("\\", "")[:500],
            "llm_event_summary": (llm.get("event_summary", "") or "").replace('"', "'").replace("\\", "")[:500]
        })
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({"events": [], "raw_count": 0, "error": str(e)[:200]}))
else:
    print(json.dumps({"events": events, "raw_count": raw_count}))

import json, urllib.request, ssl, urllib.parse

dedupe = json.loads('''$dedupe_against_thehive.message''')
new_events = dedupe.get("new_events", [])
skipped_count = dedupe.get("skipped_count", 0)

cap_hit = len(new_events) > 10
events_to_process = new_events[:10]

ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Authorization": "Bearer $thehive_api_key"
}

def severity_from_conf(c):
    try:
        cv = float(c or 0)
    except:
        cv = 0.0
    if cv >= 0.8:
        return 3
    if cv >= 0.5:
        return 2
    return 1

cases = []
case_errors = []

for ev in events_to_process:
    community_id = ev.get("community_id", "")
    ts = ev.get("timestamp", "")

    arkime_expr = f'communityId == "{community_id}"' if community_id else f'ip.dst == {ev.get("id_resp_h","")}'
    arkime_url = f"https://10.10.30.25:8005/sessions?expression={urllib.parse.quote(arkime_expr)}"

    kibana_filter_a = f"(filters:!((meta:(key:community_id,type:phrase),query:(match_phrase:(community_id:'{community_id}')))))"
    kibana_url = f"http://10.10.30.25:5601/app/dashboards#/view/2988f47d-bf0e-4a37-a284-2e055d244ed1?_g=(time:(from:now-24h,to:now))&_a={urllib.parse.quote(kibana_filter_a)}"

    severity = severity_from_conf(ev.get("llm_confidence"))

    title = f"[haccp tier1] {ev.get('ti_match_field','')}={ev.get('ti_matched_value','')} ({ev.get('ti_provider','')})"[:250]

    desc = ev.get("llm_summary", "") or ""
    if ev.get("llm_event_summary"):
        desc += f"\n\nEvent: {ev['llm_event_summary']}"
    if ev.get("zeek_uid"):
        desc += f"\nZeek UID: {ev['zeek_uid']}"
    if ts:
        desc += f"\n@timestamp: {ts}"

    # Step 1: POST case WITHOUT customFields (TheHive 4.1.24 silently drops them on POST)
    case_body = {
        "title": title,
        "description": desc[:4000],
        "severity": severity,
        "tlp": 2,
        "pap": 2,
        "tags": [
            "phase14",
            "tier1_ti_match",
            f"provider:{ev.get('ti_provider','')}",
            f"ti_type:{ev.get('ti_type','')}",
            f"match_field:{ev.get('ti_match_field','')}"
        ]
    }

    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            "$thehive_url/api/v1/case",
            data=json.dumps(case_body).encode(),
            headers=headers,
            method="POST"
        )
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=10)
        created = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        case_id = created.get("_id") or created.get("id")

        # Step 2: PATCH custom fields onto the case (POST+PATCH pattern per Correction 5)
        custom_fields = {
            "community_id": {"string": community_id or ""},
            "zeek_uid": {"string": ev.get("zeek_uid", "") or ""},
            "arkime_url": {"string": arkime_url},
            "kibana_url": {"string": kibana_url}
        }
        patch_req = urllib.request.Request(
            f"$thehive_url/api/v1/case/{case_id}",
            data=json.dumps({"customFields": custom_fields}).encode(),
            headers=headers,
            method="PATCH"
        )
        urllib.request.urlopen(patch_req, context=ctx, timeout=10)

        case_url = f"$thehive_url/index.html#!/case/{case_id}/details"
        cases.append({
            "case_id": case_id,
            "case_url": case_url,
            "title": title,
            "severity": severity,
            "community_id": community_id,
            "ti_match_field": ev.get("ti_match_field", ""),
            "ti_matched_value": ev.get("ti_matched_value", ""),
            "ti_provider": ev.get("ti_provider", ""),
            "ti_type": ev.get("ti_type", ""),
            "llm_classification": ev.get("llm_classification", ""),
            "llm_confidence": ev.get("llm_confidence", 0),
            "llm_summary": ev.get("llm_summary", ""),
            "id_orig_h": ev.get("id_orig_h", ""),
            "id_resp_h": ev.get("id_resp_h", ""),
            "id_resp_p": ev.get("id_resp_p", 0),
            "arkime_url": arkime_url,
            "kibana_url": kibana_url,
            "timestamp": ts
        })
    except Exception as e:
        case_errors.append({"community_id": community_id, "error": str(e)[:200]})

print(json.dumps({
    "cases": cases,
    "case_errors": case_errors,
    "skipped_count": skipped_count,
    "cap_hit": cap_hit,
    "total_new": len(new_events)
}))

import json

result = json.loads('''$create_cases.message''')
cases = result.get("cases", [])
skipped = result.get("skipped_count", 0)
cap_hit = result.get("cap_hit", False)
total = result.get("total_new", 0)

if not cases:
    print(json.dumps({"embed_body": json.dumps({"content": ""})}))
else:
    def color_for(sev):
        return {3: 15158332, 2: 15105570, 1: 15844367}.get(sev, 15844367)

    embeds = []
    for c in cases[:5]:
        title = f"[tier1] {c.get('ti_match_field','')}={c.get('ti_matched_value','')}"[:256]
        desc = (c.get("llm_summary", "") or "")[:150]

        fields = [
            {"name": "From \u2192 To", "value": f"{c.get('id_orig_h','')} \u2192 {c.get('id_resp_h','')}:{c.get('id_resp_p','')}", "inline": True},
            {"name": "Provider", "value": str(c.get("ti_provider", "") or "?"), "inline": True},
            {"name": "TI Type", "value": str(c.get("ti_type", "") or "?"), "inline": True},
            {"name": "Classification", "value": str(c.get("llm_classification", "") or "?"), "inline": True},
            {"name": "Confidence", "value": str(c.get("llm_confidence", "") or "?"), "inline": True},
            {"name": "Pivots", "value": f"[Kibana]({c.get('kibana_url','')}) \u00b7 [Arkime]({c.get('arkime_url','')})", "inline": False}
        ]

        footer_text = f"WF-HACCP-1 \u00b7 phase14 \u00b7 dedupe {skipped}/{total}"
        if cap_hit:
            footer_text += " \u00b7 cap hit, overflow next run"
        if len(cases) > 5:
            footer_text += f" \u00b7 +{len(cases)-5} more cases (see TheHive)"

        embed = {
            "title": title,
            "url": c.get("case_url", ""),
            "description": desc,
            "color": color_for(c.get("severity", 1)),
            "fields": fields,
            "footer": {"text": footer_text},
            "timestamp": c.get("timestamp", "")
        }
        embeds.append(embed)

    body = json.dumps({"embeds": embeds})
    print(json.dumps({"embed_body": body}))
